codeReview.summary: Fail. The current Python implementation does centralize handler attachment in python/core/logging.py, removes production print() calls, and calls setup_logging() in the runner entry points, but it still does not satisfy VAL-FOUND-005 / VAL-PY-002 because hardcoded logger names remain. The assigned handoff/transcript metadata is also inconsistent: the recorded worker session and handoff commit point to the unrelated server pino logging feature, so this review had to use the current Python code plus repository history as the primary evidence for the actual implementation.

issues.description: The feature contract explicitly requires that all getLogger() calls use __name__ (validation-contract.md lines 23-25; features.json expectedBehavior/verificationSteps). However python/core/logging.py:66-67 still uses logging.getLogger("urllib3") and logging.getLogger("playwright"). A repo-wide grep of getLogger() therefore does not "show only __name__", so the implementation does not fully satisfy VAL-FOUND-005 / VAL-PY-002.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared contract around Python logger naming is ambiguous for third-party library suppression. Validation text currently says every getLogger() call must use __name__, but the repo also configures library-specific logger levels by name inside core/logging.py.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: validation-contract.md:23-25 and 187-189 say all getLogger() calls use __name__; python/core/logging.py:66-67 sets levels via logging.getLogger("urllib3") and logging.getLogger("playwright"). If those named library loggers are intended to be allowed, AGENTS.md / validation-contract.md should document that exception explicitly.

summary: Reviewed the assigned handoff/transcript artifacts, current Python logging implementation, and related git history. The feature fails review because python/core/logging.py still contains hardcoded getLogger() names, so it does not meet the explicit "all getLogger() uses __name__" requirement; I also recorded a traceability gap in the mission metadata for this feature.
